title: Raw source datasets are absent from the workspace
detail: Only the notebook, derived tables, figures and logs are present. fraudTrain.csv and fraudTest.csv are referenced by hash and size but are not in the folder.

title: Train→test shift makes every test metric an OOD estimate
detail: Train and test are almost perfectly separable by cumulative-history features. The final model's test PR-AUC is a cross-boundary transfer estimate, not a typical generalization estimate.

title: card_prior_fraud dominates the transfer failure
detail: Removing the causal prior-fraud count raises test PR-AUC from 0.5575 to 0.8315. The feature is causally constructed but its distribution shifts sharply across the split.

title: Simulator artifacts limit external validity
detail: Several apparently predictive structures are properties of the Sparkov generator: near-universal card fraud, per-transaction merchant coordinate jitter, deterministic-ish merchant categories and impossible travel speeds.

title: One strong finding is contradicted by its own evidence
detail: The target-encoding leakage demo reports naive ρ=0.048 and causal ρ=0.048, yet its finding says full-data encoding overstates the signal.

title: Cramér's V comparisons ignore cardinality bias
detail: ZIP3 has 532 levels and V=0.148; category has 14 levels and V=0.067. Raw V is not comparable across these cardinalities.

title: Age contract violation is unresolved
detail: The minimum age is 13.9 years, below the ~18 expected for a cardholder. The record is flagged but not corrected.

title: ZIP codes lose leading zeros
detail: 116,389 transactions have ZIP values below 10,000, consistent with leading-zero loss after numeric parsing.

title: Structural missingness reaches 10.79%
detail: Prior-transaction and z-score features are missing for the first transaction on a card; amt_z_prior is missing in 10.79% of rows.

title: The cost-minimizing operating point is precision-costly
detail: At the cost-min threshold (≈0.00001), recall is 84.2% but 20,322 genuine transactions are flagged (precision 8.2%). At a 1% review budget, precision is 25.3% and 4,153 genuine transactions are flagged.

title: Optimal threshold is fragile to the false-positive cost
detail: Across $1–$50 false-positive friction, the optimal threshold moves from 0.0000 to 0.0004 and recall ranges from 91.6% to 70.2%.

title: Evidence excerpts are capped at 400 characters
detail: The notebook's log_finding function stores str(evidence)[:400]. The ledger therefore contains excerpts, not full supporting objects.

title: Phase numbering is inconsistent across artifacts
detail: Figure/table prefixes use phase0..phase5, phase7, phase8; the findings ledger uses section-phase 1..8. Phase 6 is absent from artifact names.

title: Runtime and resource telemetry is largely absent
detail: Only the end-to-end run window, six embedding timings and one SHAP timing are recorded. There is no per-phase duration, CPU/GPU utilization, VRAM or inference-latency series.

title: Seven interactive maps have no static preview
detail: Plotly 5.24.1 is incompatible with Kaleido 1.5.0, so static map exports were skipped. The HTML artifacts were retained and are included in this gallery.

title: Output bundle and full provenance digests are missing
detail: The notebook reports a 17.9 MB zip bundle, but no bundle exists. Data fingerprints are 16 hex characters rather than full SHA-256 values.
